summary: Admitted thirteen adjudicated corrections from continuation 4 of the Jujutsu research, merged from nineteen candidates across six review arms, together with two product-choice decision cards. Four candidates in the diff and merge editor cluster are deferred rather than declined, one candidate is rejected as inside a continuation-3 rejection, and one is covered by existing canon. Canonical edits and independent review remained pending at this point.

Recorded Jared's answers to the seven shape questions the Part 1 adjudication raised, verbatim "I agree with all 7 of your recommendations. You can do all the next steps.", and to the two decision cards, verbatim "Do you recommendations for the choices." Compiled as DL-058, DL-056 and DL-057 in both Decision Log sections.

Compiled the thirteen corrections into JJI-003, JJI-006, JJI-008, SCS-005, SCS-014, SCS-015 and SCS-017 with their existing schemas and fixtures, across eight commits. Every cited passage was re-read on current main before editing and the drifted line numbers were re-verified; F106 to F109 and DL-051 to DL-054 covered none of the thirteen.

Extended the contract semantic gate with the jujutsu_integration_contracts branch carrying exactly four relational rules, each with one authored negative fixture that passes JSON Schema and fails only its own rule, under the authorization recorded as q-005. Added tests/test_pm_jujutsu_closure_semantics.py and updated the scoping assertion in tests/test_pm_source_control_effects.py. No other file under scripts/ changed.

Static verification recorded for the wave: contracts pass with 1047 positives and 3420 negatives against a 1041 and 3379 baseline, the configured shard check passes, plan index validation passes, and both semantic-gate test modules pass. Three questions remain open and none blocks landing.

Applied the four cheap notes from the independent review of this branch, which carried no blocking and no should-fix finding. N1 makes a dependency step mandatory in the closure materialization order with a "contains" constraint and a negative fixture, closing an order that named no dependency step at all. N2 names q-008, q-009 and q-010 in the five canon passages that mark the unenforced obligations, so a reader follows them by id rather than by description. N3 quotes DL-058's answer whole, including the third sentence about experiment tooling that the earlier prefix dropped. N6 adds the Part 1 record's machine twin to the evidence receipts with its hash. The review's two other notes, N4 on the gate branch reading the owner schema and N5 on the pre-existing absence of minItems on frozen prefixItems lists, were recorded observations and need no change.
